title: First Purchase Month Per Customer
description: For each customer, report the calendar month of their very **first** purchase. Name the columns `customer_id` and `first_month`. Oldest purchase wins; ties don't matter. Return customers in any order.
solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(order_date)) AS first_month
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id;
hint: MIN(order_date) is each customer's first purchase; strftime down to month.
outputExplanation: Alice first bought in January, Zed in February.
